hooks.name: Log changes on save
hooks.description: Appends the filename and timestamp to CHANGELOG.md every time a file is saved, reading the file path from stdin JSON context.

action.command: powershell -Command "$input = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $json = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; $file = $json.filePath; $timestamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'; Add-Content -Path 'CHANGELOG.md' -Value \"- [$timestamp] Saved: $file\""
